annotations.title: Request an appointment or reservation by phone

description: Request that we phone a business and book an appointment or reservation within the given time slots. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 9 per successful booking (no charge if nothing can be booked).

booking_type.description: What to book, e.g. table for 4, dental check-up, boiler service.

callback_contact.description: Optional: phone/email the business may use for the booking.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

preferred_slots.description: Acceptable dates/times in order of preference.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
